name: elcarehub
description: ElcareHub — Decentralized African art marketplace on Stellar + Soroban

scripts.dev:frontend: node init && npm run dev --prefix frontend/elcarehub-app
scripts.dev:indexer: node init && npm run dev --prefix indexer
scripts.build:frontend: node init && npm run build --prefix frontend/elcarehub-app
scripts.build:indexer: node init && npm run build --prefix indexer
scripts.build:abi: node init && npm run build --prefix packages/contract-abi
scripts.live-e2e:test: bash -c 'set -a; source scripts/live-e2e/.env.live-e2e; set +a; npm run test:e2e:live --prefix frontend/elcarehub-app'
